posts.zh:
dsh-agent-team-gui 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。全局持久 Agent 小队：每个成员独立配置模型与工具策略；在 Settings 中管理、按对话选择并开关协作，普通发送按固定顺序或由模型规划执行。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-4af28386664ef1bd7d59.html
posts.en:
dsh-agent-team-gui is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Global persistent agent squads with per-agent model/tool policies: manage them in Settings, select and toggle one per conversation, then collaborate on normal sends in a fixed or model-planned order.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-4af28386664ef1bd7d59.html
